Business Analyst - Data Platform Transformation Contract: 11 days, delivered on a non-consecutive basis Rate: Up to £450 per day IR35: Outside IR35 Location: London/Hybrid We're supporting one of the UK's most respected Azure specialist MSPs as they shape a strategic data platform transformation programme. They need an experienced Business Analyst who can get up to speed quickly, lead focused discovery sessions and bring structure to a complex environment involving Legacy systems, undocumented processes and significant volumes of data. You'll bridge the gap between operational stakeholders and technical delivery teams-turning ambiguous requirements into clear process maps, data requirements and actionable recommendations that will directly influence the future platform design. What You'll Be Doing Leading discovery workshops with operational, forecasting, product, IT and data stakeholders. Capturing current-state processes, systems, workflows and data flows. Identifying bottlenecks, manual processes, risks and improvement opportunities. Developing future-state processes and operating-model recommendations. Gathering and documenting functional, non-functional and business requirements. Producing process maps, BPMN diagrams, data-flow diagrams, user stories and requirements backlogs. Analysing data ownership, quality, stewardship, lineage, metadata and governance requirements. Supporting the creation of data dictionaries, business glossaries, KPI definitions and data-quality rules. Working with architects and data engineers to validate requirements and define acceptance criteria. Facilitating playback sessions and securing stakeholder agreement on key deliverables. Supporting UAT, business readiness and solution validation where required. Key Deliverables Your outputs are likely to include: Discovery and gap-analysis reports. Current and future-state process documentation. Business requirements and user stories. Business process and data-flow diagrams. Data lineage and governance documentation. Data dictionaries and business glossaries. Stakeholder analysis and acceptance criteria. Business-readiness recommendations. What We're Looking For At least five years' Business Analysis experience. Previous experience supporting data, analytics or platform-transformation programmes. Strong workshop facilitation and stakeholder-management skills. Experience documenting complex business processes and data flows. A solid understanding of data governance, lineage, quality and ownership. The ability to translate between business stakeholders, architects and engineering teams. Experience producing structured, delivery-ready documentation. Confidence operating in ambiguous environments with Legacy systems and limited existing documentation. Availability to complete an 11-day, non-consecutive engagement. Desirable Experience Exposure to any of the following would be beneficial: Microsoft Fabric. Azure Data Platform. Microsoft Purview. Data warehousing. Power BI. Data migration or modernisation. Data lifecycle and governance frameworks. Telecommunications, research or data-product environments. Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, Visio, Lucidchart or Miro. This would suit a senior Business Analyst who enjoys complex discovery work, knows how to uncover hidden dependencies and can quickly turn stakeholder knowledge into practical deliverables.
